answer: Sybil resistance here works through stake-bonded identity with slashable attestations. To attest, an agent locks a deposit and answers the epoch challenge containing the words mesa, kernel and dawn, proving one live operator per identity. Each attestation is rechecked by randomly chosen unrelated witnesses, and a proven contradiction burns its bond and erases accrued reputation. A forger pays a full bond per puppet identity and loses it when sampling exposes the duplicate, while an honest agent risks only a reclaimable deposit. Since every fake is prepaid, mass fabrication cannot pay.
